# Examplicity Lab Development

> Instructions for remixing standalone labs and contributing repository changes.

## Remix workflow

1. Read the attached HTML and script[data-examplicity-lab-contract] JSON. The contract guides adaptation; inspect code for actual behaviour. Implementation maps can be stale after edits.
2. Identify the learning relationship, inputs, outputs, feedback and completion. Ask about audience and requested changes; agree a short plan.
3. Preserve learning relationships, invariants and selected curriculum unless the user explicitly changes them. Update affected contract guidance. Do not invent exam alignment.
4. Consult design references for changed surfaces. Preserve meaningful interactions, keyboard access and readable feedback; do not add controls just to match an example.
5. Return one complete offline HTML file with required CSS, JavaScript and assets embedded. Check changed interactions, reset, keyboard operation and narrow-screen layout.
6. If references are unavailable, say so and continue from the HTML and contract. Documentation URLs are not runtime dependencies.

## Contribute a fix

- Repository: https://github.com/timcarpe/examplicity
- Submit focused fixes and improvements as PRs. Open an issue to agree larger changes first: https://github.com/timcarpe/examplicity/issues
- Fork and create a branch; follow AGENTS.md. Edit labs-src/<subject>/<slug>/lab.html and update lab-contracts/<subject>/<slug>.lab.json when behaviour or guidance changes.
- Run npm ci, npm run lab -- inspect <slug>, npm run lab -- validate <slug>, and npm run lab -- build <slug>. Review and include generated output; check changed behaviour in the browser and offline download.
- Describe the lab URL, problem, change and validation; include screenshots for visual changes. An LLM without repository access can prepare a patch and PR description.
- Personal remixes edit downloaded HTML. Repository PRs edit source and regenerate output; do not replace source with a packaged download.


## Core references

- [Remix instructions](https://www.examplicity.org/developer#remix): Adaptation workflow and offline requirements.
- [Contribution instructions](https://www.examplicity.org/developer#contribute): Source ownership and focused PRs.
- [Publication checks](https://www.examplicity.org/developer#publish): Build and validation commands.
- [Living design guide](https://www.examplicity.org/developer/design-language.html): Visual authority, exact concept colours, activity bar, Working and stage controls, feedback and movable completion cards.
- [Guide stylesheet](https://www.examplicity.org/developer/design-language.css): Exact copyable starter CSS extracted from the living guide; use its markup for Working, stages and completion cards.
- [Written style contract](https://www.examplicity.org/developer/lab-style-contract.md): Adaptation rules; the style guide takes precedence over conflicting kit styling.
- [Lab Kit 0.3.0](https://www.examplicity.org/developer/lab-kit/0.3.0/README.md): Optional guide-aligned authoring capabilities. Existing publication remains pinned to 0.2.1 until deliberately migrated.
- [Lab Contract](https://www.examplicity.org/developer/lab-contract): Adaptation guidance, fields, semantic locators, and lifecycle.
- [Lab Contract v1 schema](https://www.examplicity.org/developer/lab-contract.schema.json): Machine-readable JSON Schema.

## Repository model

- `labs-src/<subject>/<slug>/lab.html`: Maintainable lab source.
- `lab-contracts/<subject>/<slug>.lab.json`: Authoritative adaptation guidance in a separate tree.
- `app/labs.ts`: Catalogue metadata and site syllabus alignment.
- `labs-src/manifest.json`: Publication registry and pinned tool releases.
- `public/labs/<subject>/<slug>.html`: Generated site artifact; not an authoring source.
- `vendor/lab-kit/0.2.1/`: Pinned browser helpers used by compiled labs.
- `tools/lab-publication-profile/`: Constraints for the offline single-HTML artifact.

## Commands

- `npm run labs:sync`: Generate publication artifacts.
- `npm run labs:sync:check`: Check compilation, managed content, styles, standalone downloads, and catalogue-wide contract preservation.
- `npm run labs:contract:check`: Check sidecar contracts and their compiled/downloaded copies.
- `npm run lab -- inspect <slug>`: Inspect a lab package and its contract.
- `npm run lab -- validate <slug>`: Run focused validation for one lab.
- `npm run lab -- build <slug>`: Compile one lab to its normal public path.

## Current interfaces

- Compiled labs expose the `LabKit` browser global.
- No public per-lab state or control API is implemented.
- No Examplicity lab MCP server is implemented.
